professionalSummary: Hi, I'm Anthony Silvia—a dynamic problem-solver at the intersection of software design, innovation, and user-centric solutions. I currently serve as an Associate Product Designer at Lowe's, crafting seamless experiences for customers and internal teams. At the same time, I'm the Principal at NodeDa, where I lead the development of groundbreaking tools like live transcription software (NodeDa Lingo) and other amazing projects. With a strong foundation in UX research, web development, and startup growth, I specialize in delivering intuitive, scalable solutions that solve real-world problems while pushing the boundaries of technology.
